title: 第七百九十二章 蓝瞳映夜 红气吞殇第七百九十一章 双塔绝巅 月下弈局
content_zh:
花百漾眸底戾气暗涌，心头早已被虫小蝶的拖沓周旋磨得不耐。
鼻腔溢出一声冷哼。
他抬手凌空一探，五指虚握，精准无比扣住飞射而来的酒坛！
“嘭！”
沉猛力道尽数被他单手稳稳卸尽。
千斤酒势落于掌心稳如磐石，分毫未晃！
他仰头猛灌一口，辛辣酒气入喉，却难解心头郁躁！
那双深邃眼眸死死盯着对面的虫小蝶，眸光冰冷沉凝，裹挟着浓浓的不耐与愠怒。
显然已是极致厌烦这般无谓纠缠！
虫小蝶见状，陡然放声大笑！
爽朗肆意的笑声炸开，却瞬间被狂暴凛冽的高空风声吞噬大半。
只剩几分桀骜回荡夜空！
“花宗主！”
他敛去笑意，声线陡然清冽铿锵。
穿透漫天风声，字字清晰，“你执意索要‘蝶刃剑法’。那便睁大双眼，好好看清楚！”
话音落，风云骤寂！
立在塔尖的虫小蝶周身劲气轰然勃发。
浑厚真气自体内奔腾炸开，一圈澄澈通透的湛蓝色剑芒骤然包裹周身。
流光溢转，莹润夺目！
头顶虚空，无尽剑息疯狂汇拢凝聚。

一缕缕冲天蓝焰扶摇直上，灼灼燃于皓月之下，气焰滔天，撼动四野！
漫天虚空，骤然响起密密麻麻、连绵不绝的蝶翼振颤之声！
无数无形蝶影迎风盘旋、翻飞激荡。
振翅嗡鸣尖锐清越，层层叠叠、直刺耳膜。
肃杀之气瞬间笼罩整座荒寺双塔！
下一刻，虫小蝶原本温润的黑眸骤然蜕变，一双澄澈妖异的湛蓝瞳眸猛地亮起！
蓝芒彻彻透亮，摄人心魄！
他迎风昂首，一声狂啸冲破云霄！
啸声苍凉霸道，裹挟无尽剑意。
震得长空颤栗、长风骤停！
对面塔尖，始终傲立世间、无敌半生的花百漾。
content_en:
There was an undercurrent of anger in Hua Baiyang's eyes, and her heart had already been worn out by Chong Xiaodie's procrastination.
A cold snort escaped from his nose.
He raised his hand and looked into the air, using his five fingers to grasp the wine jar flying towards him with great precision!
"Bang!"
All Shen Meng's strength was firmly removed by him with one hand.
Thousands of kilograms of wine fell into the palm of my hand as steady as a rock, not shaking at all!
He raised his head and took a deep sip. The spicy wine smell entered his throat, but it was difficult to relieve the depression in his heart!
Those deep eyes were staring at Chong Xiaodie across from him, their eyes cold and condensed, filled with deep impatience and sullenness.
Obviously, he is extremely tired of such unnecessary entanglement!
Seeing this, Chong Xiaodie burst out laughing!
Hearty and wanton laughter burst out, but was instantly swallowed up by the violent and biting high-altitude wind.
Only a few traces of unruliness echoed in the night sky!
"Master Hua!"
He suppressed his smile and his voice suddenly became clear and sonorous.
Penetrating the sound of wind in the sky, the words were clear, "You insist on asking for the 'Butterfly Blade Sword Technique'. Then open your eyes wide and see clearly!"
As soon as the words fell, the storm suddenly became silent!
Chong Xiaodie, who was standing at the top of the tower, was filled with energy.
The thick true energy surged and exploded from the body, and a circle of clear blue sword light suddenly enveloped the whole body.
The light is overflowing and dazzling!
In the void above his head, endless sword breath gathered and condensed crazily.
Wisps of blue flames soared up into the sky, burning under the bright moon. Their arrogance was overwhelming, shaking the whole world!
The sky filled the void, and suddenly there was a dense and continuous sound of trembling butterfly wings!
Countless invisible butterfly shadows are circling, flying and stirring in the wind.
The flapping wings and the buzzing sound are sharp and clear, layer upon layer, straight to the ear membranes.
The chilling atmosphere instantly enveloped the entire twin towers of the deserted temple!
The next moment, Chong Xiaodie's original gentle black eyes suddenly transformed, and a pair of clear and enchanting blue pupils suddenly lit up!
The blue light is so bright and breathtaking!
He raised his head in the wind, and a roar broke through the sky!
The whistle is desolate and domineering, carrying endless sword intent.
The shock made the sky tremble and the wind suddenly stopped!
On the opposite side of the tower, Hua Baiyang has always stood proudly in the world and has been invincible for half her life.
